game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens, the chapel gardens: the herald must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before rogue crows can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens: the chapel gardens
core_gameplay_loop: In Chapel Gardens, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before rogue crows can use it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the wave_target value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the castle gate using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The castle gate reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the castle gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Chapel Gardens'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Chapel Gardens.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The castle gate reached with actions_used <= 19.
